tagline: A new comedy that proves there's more to attraction than meets the eye.
about: A dumped high school king bets he can turn the school's quiet art student into prom queen in six weeks.

    Before the DanceLaney's falafel shift wrapsLaney's falafel shift. Tahini, warm pita.How to make it2 x 400g tins of chickpeas, drained and patted dry1 small brown onion, chopped2 garlic cloves1 cup flat-leaf parsley2 tsp ground cumin3 tbsp plain flour500ml vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp tahini1 lemon4 pita breads2 tomatoes, dicedPulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, flour and salt to a coarse paste and roll into 16 balls.Fry in hot oil in batches until deep brown and crisp.Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, salt and water until pourable.Warm the pita, fill with falafel and tomato and drizzle with tahini.Brock Hudson's Real World nachosTaylor dumps Zack for Brock. Beans, cheddar.How to make it230g plain corn chips400g tin black beans, drained1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground cumin200g vintage cheddar, grated1 cup tomato salsa2 ripe avocados1 lime150g sour cream2 tbsp sliced pickled jalapenosWarm the beans with the paprika, cumin, a splash of water and salt, crushing a few.Mash the avocados with the lime juice and salt.Layer the chips, beans and cheddar on a tray and bake at 200°C until the cheese melts.Top with salsa, guacamole, sour cream and jalapenos and serve straight away.Simon's breakfast muffinsLaney has his breakfast ready. Get up, Simon.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.The Main EventHacky sack meatball subsZack's hacky sack act. Meatballs, provolone.How to make it600g beef mince60g fresh breadcrumbs1 egg40g parmesan, finely grated2 garlic cloves, crushed700g jar tomato passata1 tsp dried oregano4 long crusty rolls8 slices of provolone1/2 cup basil leavesMix the mince, crumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt, and roll into 20 balls.Brown the meatballs in a hot pan.Add the passata, oregano and the rest of the garlic and simmer until thick.Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, top with provolone and grill until melted.Tuck in the basil and serve.Beach day fish tacosLaney says yes to the beach. Chipotle slaw.How to make it600g firm white fish fillets1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground cumin2 tbsp olive oil8 small corn tortillas1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded3 limes125g sour cream1 tbsp chipotle in adobo, chopped1/2 cup coriander leavesRub the fish with the spices, oil and salt.Toss the cabbage with the juice of 2 limes and salt, and stir the chipotle into the sour cream.Grill the fish until just flaking, then break into chunks.Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle cream, coriander and lime.Last Dance SweetsRed dress on the stairs strawberry shortcakeLaney comes down the stairs. Berries, cream.How to make it250g self-raising flour60g caster sugar, plus 2 tbsp for the berries80g cold butter, cubed180ml buttermilk500g strawberries, sliced300ml thickened cream1 tsp vanilla extractToss the strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar and leave to go juicy.Rub the butter into the flour and 60g sugar, stir in the buttermilk and pat out 3cm thick.Cut 4 rounds and bake at 210°C until golden.Whip the cream with the vanilla, split the shortcakes and fill with berries and cream.The Punch BowlLaney's foghorn prom punchLaney's foghorn sees off Dean. Pineapple fizz.How to make it500ml pineapple juice500ml cranberry juice750ml lemonade2 limes, sliced1 cup frozen raspberries2 cups ice cubesStir the pineapple and cranberry juices together in a punch bowl.Add the lime slices, frozen raspberries and ice.Top with lemonade just before serving.Sparkling water by the poolNot the last dance.
